Name: EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons for Cornucopia - More Flowers
Author: ShilohAreles
Description:
[color=#fff2cc][b]THIS MOD IS FOR STARDEW VERSION 1.6.

[/b][/color][size=3]To Do:[/size]
[size=2]Adjust code/sprite so the honey matches the shade of flowers that come in multiple shades [will take time][/size]

This is an add on pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23373]EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons EBAGI Pack[/url], to match their sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]. This mod [i]will[/i] require [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿, the unofficial update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿﻿﻿ to function.[i][size=1]

[/size][/i]Please consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28512/]EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons for Cornucopia: More Crops[/url], if you have the parent mod installed and want more fanci-fied artisan goods!

Installation (stand alone)
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url] from github and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]CMF[/url]﻿﻿, [u]this is mandatory.[/u]
[*]Unzip the file [BAGI] Fancy AGI for Cornucopia - More Flowers into your mods folder.
[/list]
﻿[size=1]This mod can safely be uninstalled mid game without issue. Just delete the file from your Mods folder.

Note: Because some flowers, if not all of cornucopia's flowers come in various shades -- for now, honey may not match the color of the flower that was harvested. I'll have to look into this further to see if anything can be done besides creating a color modifying version.
[/size]
If you already have Aimon111's parent mod pack, you could also unzip these files there for convenience.

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url] for their permission to pursue this add on.
